identity.title: [v0.92.1][tools][csdlc-v3] Fix terminal authority reporting and issue-create parity

values.goal: Fix C-SDLC v3 terminal authority reporting and add typed GitHub issue-create parity.
values.required_outcome: v3 reports operational terminal authority truthfully after cutover and can create GitHub issues through the v3 typed mutation path with durable intent, authenticated readback, and receipt binding.
authority_boundary: Do not weaken canonical selector checks or caller-authored authority rejection.
Do not introduce raw gh issue create as a lifecycle route.
Do not delete v2 code in this issue; v2 removal is tracked separately.
operator_constraints: Follow the GitHub issue-create model for title/body/labels/assignees/milestone.
